Episode 185. The Remaining People (7)
Currently, there was not a single power watching over Sword Emperor Land.
Since the contamination areas left by Gliak in the world have not yet been fully cleaned up, the most serious Sword Emperor Land was completely out of the question.

"If we use this place as a shipyard, we won't have to deal with any power. There's no reason to doubt it as it appears to be severely chaotic, and even if they were suspicious, touching Sword Emperor Land... would inevitably mean they want to cross swords with us."
The symbolic meaning of 'the land where Ron fell' also played an important role as Dante had said.
They could not dare to disturb the grave of the hero who saved the world without a just cause.
Dante, who filled Jin's glass with alcohol and made a toast.
The two smiled and raised their glasses.

"The groundwork for the shipyard will be completed in no time if our knights, technicians, Black King Group, and Ghost Group are deployed. Our researchers were surprised when they saw Dr. Kwal's blueprints and works."
"Indeed, he's a genius."
What the imperial researchers examined were not the blueprints of the golden fleet.
It was the blueprint of the newly implemented underground shipyard and the advanced equipment for construction.
With just that, the empire's researchers couldn't help but admire that the Bamel Alliance was hiding technology centuries ahead.
If you combine the capabilities of Valeria and Kwal, it was not wrong at all.
"But I am a bit worried."
"Is it because he is of Ganesto's bloodline like the Monster?"
"Yes. If Padler's will is true, Dr. Kwal might become Ganesto's puppet at some point. And maybe…"
Jin paused and swallowed a sigh.
"It might also apply to our knights, who are the children of the Monster. We too would have received a bit of Ganesto's blood."
Of course, that was the worst-case scenario.
So far, no one has shown such signs except for Joshua, but it was a fact that the remaining knights were born from Rosa's belly.

"It's a horrible story. But I have a feeling you and the remaining knights are somehow not affected. If Lokia Ganesto could intervene in your inner selves, the Monster War would not have ended as it did."
"That's true. But we'll continue to check on me, the knights, and Dr. Kwal through Valeria."
So far, there has been no record of any relation to Ganesto.
If it doesn't come out even after Valeria finds the succession records and raises the level of record magic to the maximum, they will be completely relieved.
"Don't worry too much. Anyway, now the important thing is the construction of the shipyard, and the replenishment of magic, materials, and manpower for the mass production of ships."
"I have something in mind for magic."
"What is it?"
"Mirror."
"Colon's artifact?"
-"Yes. What this seal is holding back is the source of infinite magic, itself. And the endlessly expanding magic can erase this world at any time..."
A statement made by the god of magic, Clam, during the mass murder of the Colonne natives.
Since then, Jin has been heeding Clam's warning and has been using the 'mirror' as sparingly as possible.
He used it only once in a truly desperate moment, when he had to save his comrades and people.
"Didn't you say it's a dangerous item?"
"Right. I'm not just trying to use it because I'm in a hurry and willing to take risks. I've found a way to use it safely."
More accurately, it's not securing, but confirming.
From the time Jin left for seclusion at Lafrarosa until now, he has achieved explosive growth.
In all areas of aura, magic, and spirit.
As a result, Jin was able to control the seal of Soldieret, which blocks the power of the mirror, and absorb it.
Plus, there was a double safety measure. Even if Jin was controlling the seal of the mirror and an unexpected situation occurred, he could check the state of the mirror through record magic.
When Jin explained this, Dante nodded.
"If you say so, you should be able to use it without any problem. Then do we just need to solve the problem of manpower and resources?"
"Magicians from all over who have confirmed the existence of Valeria will come. Of course, that alone will not solve all the manpower problems, so we will have to actively recruit people."
"I'll see to it immediately. For resources, except for steel, we can gather enough within the empire, even if it's a bit of a stretch."
The most important resource was steel.
High purity steel that does not distort even when a large amount of magic is infused was most needed for shipbuilding.
It was seriously insufficient even if all of the resources from Runkandel and the Barmel Alliance were combined.
Given the current situation where it is insufficient just for rebuilding the damaged areas and supplying weapons, it was necessary to trade with external forces to get steel.
"I'm going to meet Kinzelo soon to negotiate that part."
"If you're in charge of the negotiation, there'll be a significant unfair trade again."

"Well, this time we don't have many cards to play, so if they're uncooperative, we'll have to go with what we have. Just asking for that much steel is a declaration of shipbuilding, so just the negotiation itself is burdensome."
"Hmm."
"I'm meeting with the Minche Blacksmith's Guild soon, hoping to secure some with the reputation of Picon Nim..."
Just as Jin finished speaking, Dante suddenly seemed to remember something and clapped his hands. Clap!
"Huh?"
"What's up? Dante."
"Come to think of it, I remember my grandfather saying something when I was a kid!"

- Ha! Is there really no way to persuade the Minche Blacksmith's Guild? They're so arrogant while under our protection! If only we could get along with them, our empire's steel possession could far surpass the two major families.
"It was several years ago when the contract with Sirron Kyung was rejected, Lord. Don't be too upset.

-Carmine, you call that comfort. Sirron was only rejected, but I was chased away as soon as I mentioned an exclusive contract! Sirron is scary, and I am not scary. Tsk! Grandson, come over here and sing me a song. I can't seem to shake this mood.
-Yes, Grandfather! What song would you like me to sing?
-I would like to hear the Black Emperor's March, which you composed and wrote the lyrics for.
It was something that happened when Dante was six years old.
When he explained the memory, Jin's eyes sparkled.

"The Black Emperor's March? You really made such a song when you were...... No, that's not the important thing. The empire's iron reserves surpasses the two major families, did Sir Ron really say that?"
"Yes, he did."
"Even if you consider the entire island of blacksmiths to be iron, it doesn't make sense, is there something more?"
"There wouldn't be a case where my grandfather would lie, there must be something!"

It was supposed to be information that Jin should have known without this conversation; that the 'Blacksmith's Association' had an enormous amount of iron. It was written in the highly classified documents of Runkandel that were lost due to the sacrilege.
Jin did not know this fact, but anyway, he felt a sigh of relief.
"I have a feeling. I think things will work out easily."
"Oh!"
"We need to go to the blacksmith's island right away."
"Are we going now?"
"We have to finish the alcohol that I was drinking with Sir Ron. Let's drink slowly, I have a lot to say to Sir Ron."
"I think he will scold us for drinking alcohol here when we are in a hurry."
"Well, it's only a bottle."
The two laughed and finished their drinks.
The Blacksmith's Island.
Located in the unprotected zone of the northern maritime border of the empire, the island was not that large, about the size of a small city.

As it was an unprotected area, the blacksmith's island always received protection from the empire. Quite a large number of personnel and budget were invested, but from the empire's perspective, they had to receive weapons from the association even if they had to do so.
Not only the empire, but Runkandel also periodically sent knights to exterminate monsters near the island, and even Zifel provided various help to the association.

While receiving all this, these people, who have never bowed to anyone, it would not be an exaggeration to say that the Blacksmith's Association is actually the most exclusive and proud group in the world.
Jin was in a state where he had arrived in the waters near the island with Sirius and Vin Branche on the motorboat.
The island seen from afar was giving off a gloomy feel even in broad daylight.
"...Would those annoying guys really bow their heads just because of Master Picon's presence?"
Sirius said. She too had an unpleasant memory of visiting here a few times with Talarius.
"The possibility is about 90%, Sir Sirius."
"Meaning it's not 100%. I wonder if they will thank us for the demons' temple, given how shameless they are."
"Don't worry too much, let's just go."
The announcement that 'Picon Minche' was coming had already been sent.
For Picon, who had been dead for nearly a thousand years, it would have been an announcement they had never received before.
Actually, once they arrived, Jin was a bit nervous.

Although it was well known that the association was made up of fanatic followers of Picon Minche, it was uncertain whether they could 'unconditionally' secure an exclusive contract, as Sirius had said.
The moment the association refused, they were burdened by the fact that they had no choice but to deal with Kinzelo and Bitzi.
As the motorboat swam towards the harbor, the association members who were already there glared at the group with narrowed eyes.
Jin focused his gaze on one of them.
It was a person with a 'anvil' shaped tattoo on his forehead.
'That person must represent anvil among fire, hammer, and anvil.'
At first glance, the anvil seemed to have a frustrating impression that conversation would not go through at all.
"Halt!"
"Are you the Little House Lord of Runcandel?"
"Yes, I am."
"Provide proof to confirm your identity!"
Despite the black coat with ten black swords plainly visible, Anvil took a rude attitude.
"Each of the people next to you also need to reveal their identity."
"I am Sirius Endormada, the Little Archduke of Bigung."
"I am... Vin Brangshe."

"We allow the Little House Lord of Runcandel and the Little Archduke of Bigung to enter, but Vin Brangshe is not allowed. Especially, the Little House Lord of Runcandel has a lot to explain to us today! You've been lending out the weapons we provided to Runcandel without any discussion? Moreover, that ridiculous official document……."
Jin sent a signal to Vin, as if there was no more to say.
It meant to manifest Picon right away.
As Vin Brangshe flipped his eyes and started his incarnation state, Anvil trembled all over as he saw Vin's appearance changing like Picon.
"Is... is it really, Lord Picon Minche......!"
[Yes! I am the legendary blacksmith, Picon Minche! I am currently also the god of blacksmiths.]
Thump!
Anvil and the association members kneeled down blinking their eyes.
Anvil didn't have any doubts about the manifested Picon's appearance.
As Anvil quickly corrected his posture and kneeled, the association members also promptly followed him.
Soon after, Anvil said, satisfying Jin.
"From now on, everything of our association, even a grain of sand on this island, belongs to Lord Picon. Please forgive us for not recognizing Lord Picon from the beginning and showing disrespect."
